questions.source_content:
GAZETTE NOTIFICATION
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Jalore
Date: 5 March 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/239)
Subject: Installation of Rooftop Solar Plants and Quarterly Energy Audit in Office Buildings (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jalore division are hereby informed that under 'Installation of Rooftop Solar Plants and Quarterly Energy Audit in Office Buildings', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 10 March in the central pending wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #339) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jalore, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and pending movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jalore), 2. Budget Reconciliation #149, 3. Digital Indexing.
Additional District Collector
Mahendra Singh Rathore
solution_steps: 1. Click inside the Second Paragraph.
2. Set Spacing After to '12 pt' and Line Spacing to '2.0'.
